$comment: The ONE fixture of the output normalization (DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §5, §9): a compiled program's stdout and
its expected output are compared after line ends become LF (CR LF, CR, LF, NEL, LS, PS and FF: the line ends
.NET's String.ReplaceLineEndings reads), each line loses its trailing spaces (spaces only) and trailing line ends
are dropped. The rule exists in two languages by nature, run.py's normalize() and CutRunner.Normalize in
tests/Cobol.Net.Tests.Conformance/CompilerUnderTest.cs, and ConformanceSuiteRunnerDriftTests holds BOTH to every
case below, so the two runners of the suite compare outputs on one basis.

cases.name: lf, with a final line end
cr then cr lf is two line ends
nel, ls, ps and ff end lines
a vertical tab does not end a line
trailing spaces of each line go
a last line of spaces goes
an inner line of spaces becomes empty and stays
